content.text:
**Weekly briefing:** There's no fixed schedule for the Home "Weekly briefing" card. It's computed live from your current data every time Home loads, and only shows findings marked important. Its AI wording is cached for 7 days, and the cache also resets whenever the underlying facts change.

The separate scheduled weekly summary is different. A cron runs daily at 00:00 UTC (`vercel.json`) and generates a summary once per period when your summary cadence is set to weekly, starting Monday at your summary time in your timezone. If the cadence is set to monthly or none, it runs on that schedule instead. I didn't check the default cadence for new workspaces.

**Cash flow chart:** Clicking an In or Out bar already opened that month's breakdown. I added a dashed vertical line at the clicked month, drawn only on the side you clicked (in or out). The other months still fade as before.

I read "the dott line" as this dashed marker. If you meant something else, such as a line across the whole chart or a different style, tell me and I'll change it.

Changes are in `components/chart.tsx`, `app/home-trend-chart.tsx` and `app/home-sections.tsx`, committed as `2b2fbe33`. The related tests and eslint pass, and the typecheck printed no errors. I didn't check the chart in a browser.
